errors.evidence: The figure is a combined chart, consisting of a pie chart and a stacked bar chart that breaks down one of the pie chart's segments. The description incorrectly identifies it as only a pie chart.

errors.text_span: Осата x е ориентирана по посока на часовниковата стрелка и важи от 0% до 100%, като етикетите са разположени равномерно. Осата y е ориентирана по посока на часовниковата стрелка и важи от 0% до 100%, като етикетите са разположени равномерно.
errors.evidence: The description invents x and y axes for a pie chart, which does not have such axes. This information is completely fabricated and does not exist in the figure.

errors.text_span: Сегментът с най-голям размер е “Geothermal” с 58,9%, следван от “Wind” с 34.2%, “Hydro” с 12.7%, “Solid fossil fuels” с 18.3%, “Nuclear energy” с 30.8%, “Renewable energy” с 9.3%, “Crude oil” с 3.9% и “Other” с 3.4%.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence is a jumble of incorrect data assignments. It mixes categories and values from the pie chart and the stacked bar chart. For example, it states 'Geothermal' is 58.9% (the value for 'Bioenergy & waste'), 'Wind' is 34.2% (the value for 'Renewable energy'), 'Renewable energy' is 9.3% (the value for 'Natural gas'), and swaps the values for 'Crude oil' (3.4%) and 'Other' (3.9%). The list is factually incorrect and misleading.

errors.text_span: В горната част на диаграмата има текстова анотация, която гласи “Source: Eurostat (online data codes: nrg_bal_c)” и етикет “eurostat”.
errors.evidence: The source information and Eurostat logo are located at the bottom of the figure, not the top as stated in the description.
